archetype_rationale: The title is literally Forward Deployed AI Engineer, and the day-to-day matches: 'work directly with Zipline teams to own GenAI strategy and implementation', 'iterating directly with users', and up to 50% travel 'into the Field' to deploy into operational teams.
notes: Internal-facing FDE: deploys into Zipline's own ops teams (aviation, fulfillment, maintenance), not external clients — 'hands-on AI startup CTO inside Zipline', reporting to Head of Operations. Success metric is adoption ('systems that are adopted, trusted, and used in daily operations'), so the resume should foreground shipped-and-adopted internal tools. In-office South San Francisco, cash range $112.5K-$300K. JD explicitly says 'Make sure your resume highlights what you have built, shipped, automated, scaled' — bias bullets toward concrete builds over analysis.
